gloss: to believe blindly; to have blind faith in

definitions.gloss: to believe blindly; to have blind faith in
definitions.explanation: To believe in something uncritically and without evidence or rational judgment.

examples.japanese: うわさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{妄信|もうしん}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{妄信|もうしん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He has blind faith in that theory.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{妄信|もうしん}せず、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important not to blindly trust information on the internet and to verify things yourself.

notes:
Composed of {妄|もう} (delusion; recklessness) + {信|しん} (belief; faith) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Strongly negative — always implies that the belief is irrational or misguided. Used critically, often in contexts about misinformation, propaganda, superstition, or cults.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{妄信|もうしん}する: to blindly trust information
- ⟦{権威|けんい}→権威：13173_keni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{妄信|もうしん}する: to have blind faith in authority
- {妄信|もうしん}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない: one must not blindly believe
- {妄信|もうしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な: blindly faithful; uncritical

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe — neutral; simply means to believe or trust
- ⟦{盲信|もうしん}→盲信：09239_moushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to believe blindly — same pronunciation but different kanji ({盲|もう} = blind); essentially synonymous, with ⟦{盲信|もうしん}→盲信：09239_moushin⟧ being slightly more common
- ⟦{鵜呑|うの}み→鵜呑み：27228_unomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to swallow whole — to accept without question; more colloquial
